historical_reviews.deepseek: Its command may be one valid path, but silently discards the source's distinct in-band opcode and cannot interpret storage mode from untyped bytes.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly gates the read on package-owner resolution and prohibits clearing the evidence under review.
historical_reviews.history: The invalidated prior-run record was found but not used as authority; SEL clear, storage-mode set and general LAN inventory are separate functions.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Conflicting private opcodes are a source-identity problem, not a reason to probe both on a live BMC.

original_test_intent: Read the current SEL storage/retention mode from one verified BMC and compare the decoded value with the project logging policy without changing or clearing event records.
original_method: Keep both source opcodes visible and issue neither until the Wistron artifact maps each transport, selector and response enum; lan print is excluded as a storage-mode oracle.
manual_activity: The logging/package owner decides the authoritative in-band and OOB opcode mapping, selector requirements, mode enumeration and expected SEL retention policy.
required_inputs: Approved mapping for in-band 0x30/0x82 and OOB 0x30/0x43
Response length, mode enum and reserved values
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL, dmesg or syslog
Do not probe both conflicting opcodes
Do not issue Set SEL Storage Mode
Do not use lan print as evidence
Validate completion and exact response length
No reset, power action or automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify target and approved route/opcode contract
Preserve current SEL inventory and logging evidence
Issue exactly one approved getter request
Validate completion, length, enum and reserved fields
Compare decoded mode with logging policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: OOB 0x30/0x43 matches one Procedure line but does not establish its relation to in-band 0x30/0x82 or provide the mode decoder; the result cannot be validated by lan print.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After vendor mapping approval, issue only the route-specific getter opcode with its documented selector, parse the exact storage-mode enum and compare it with the approved SEL policy.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both source opcodes, selector placeholder and 10/5 timing are preserved pending resolution; no opcode equivalence or mode value is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Pin one getter to transport and firmware, validate its response structurally, decode storage policy through the vendor enum and retain SEL evidence untouched.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds protocol identity and a SEL-policy oracle while removing unrelated LAN validation and evidence deletion.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The read does not validate changing the mode, rollover behavior, event retention under capacity or SEL clearing.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Executing the wrong private opcode may call an unrelated OEM function even when completion is zero; an undocumented mode byte can invert overwrite-versus-stop-on-full interpretation.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API may substitute only if it reports the identical storage-policy enum and route mapping; standard lan print and generic SEL listing are not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Approved target/firmware/opcode/route mapping and parser version
Redacted exact request/response, completion and timestamp
No set, clear, reset, power or other logging mutation audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master assigns different opcodes to in-band (0x82) and OOB (0x43) without documenting equivalence, supplies a selector only for one path and judges SEL mode through unrelated LAN output. These cannot establish one authoritative getter.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The SEL storage-mode read purpose is clear. A vendor mapping, decoder and policy oracle are identifiable prerequisites, so the record is REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION rather than irreducibly BLOCKED.

review_improvement: Stops live probing of conflicting OEM opcodes and turns the eventual read into a route-qualified, policy-decoded operation that preserves the SEL it is meant to characterize.
independent_technical_reasoning: Private opcode identity is part of the test purpose: two different command bytes cannot be treated as equivalent based on a shared title. Because storage mode controls future retention rather than LAN state, the only valid oracle is a documented mode enum plus the approved logging policy, with existing events preserved as diagnostic evidence.
